scenes.say: Good news – and gold drops? There's a reason.

scenes.text: The dollar, interest rates and uncertainty move the gold price.
scenes.say: Three drivers move gold: the dollar, rates and uncertainty.

scenes.title: STEP 01 · The dollar
scenes.say: Step one: when the dollar rises, gold often falls.

scenes.title: STEP 02 · Interest rates
scenes.say: Step two: gold pays no interest. When rates fall, gold wins.

scenes.title: STEP 03 · Uncertainty
scenes.say: Step three: in a crisis, investors flee into gold.

scenes.text: Reading only the chart and ignoring the news. They belong together.
scenes.say: Common mistake: chart only, no news. They belong together.

scenes.title: No time to analyze the market *yourself*?
scenes.say: No time to track all of this yourself?

scenes.title: Understand first. Then trade.
scenes.say: I explain it live in my free group. Comment GOLD.
